label: WeChat
terms_note: Free; the tenant needs a WeChat Official Account — most APIs (publish, customer-service messages, templates, comments, datacube) require a VERIFIED SERVICE ACCOUNT (认证服务号; subscription accounts get a subset), a server IP whitelist and a developer secret; access_token via GET /cgi-bin/token grant_type=client_credential (7200 s, one issuer per account); per-endpoint daily quotas (接口调用次数) per account; customer-service replies allowed only after a user action, max 5 messages within 48 h; broadcast (群发) limited to 4 per month for service accounts (1 per day for subscription accounts); to operate OTHER tenants' accounts a 微信开放平台第三方平台 (component_access_token, authorizer tokens) is the sanctioned route.

reference.limits: - Per-endpoint daily quotas per account (`openapi/quota/get`); token fetch quota 2000/day. - Customer-service window 48 h, 5 messages; templates / subscribe messages need category approval; 群发 caps. - 微信公众平台运营规范 forbids induced sharing, spam and off-platform automation of personal accounts.

adapter.envelope_note: Failures arrive in HTTP 200 as a non-zero errcode with errmsg (e.g. 40001 invalid credential, 42001 access_token expired, 45009 daily quota, 45028 no masssend quota, 48001 api unauthorized); a success body may omit errcode. An expired token is not a 401, so the token is refreshed by its TTL (expires_in 7200 s).

fields.name: appid
fields.help: AppID of the Official Account (服务号 / 公众号), sent with the AppSecret to GET https://api.weixin.qq.com/cgi-bin/token?grant_type=client_credential (https://developers.weixin.qq.com/doc/service/api/base/api_getaccesstoken); the calling server's IP must be on the account's API IP whitelist (errcode 40164 otherwise).

fields.name: secret
fields.help: AppSecret of the Official Account. The returned access_token (7200 s) travels as the access_token query parameter of every call; fetching a new one invalidates tokens held by other servers of the same account.

adapter.terms: Mass sends, comment management and mass delete are limited to verified (认证) accounts; mass sends are quota-limited per account type (errcode 45028 when used up) and may await an administrator's confirmation when API 群发保护 is on.

me.note: The Official Account API has no 'who am I' call: getApiDomainIp (GET /cgi-bin/get_api_domain_ip) verifies that the AppID / AppSecret mint a working access_token and returns {ip_list} of WeChat API servers.

publish_text.note: PUBLISHES TO ALL FOLLOWERS: sendAll {filter: {is_to_all: true}, msgtype: 'text', text: {content}} submits a mass-send (群发) job to every follower of the Official Account; it consumes the account's limited mass-send quota (errcode 45028 'has no masssend quota') and, with API 群发保护 on, waits up to 30 minutes for an administrator's confirmation. Success means the job was accepted, not delivered. `id` is msg_id (the send task id). `reply_to` is ignored. No clientmsgid is sent, so WeChat dedupes identical content to the same audience within 24 h by its own digest.

read_comments.note: listComment {msg_data_id (`post_id`: the numeric msg_data_id returned when an ARTICLE (mpnews) was mass-sent, not the msg_id of a text send), begin, count (<50), type: 0 (ordinary + selected comments)} for the first article of the send. Verified accounts only (88000 'without comment privilege'). created_at is a Unix timestamp; the account's reply sits under raw.reply; author is the commenter's openid (absent for non-WeChat identities).

delete.note: DESTRUCTIVE: deleteMassMsg {msg_id, article_idx: 0} invalidates the body of ALL articles of that API mass send ('该字段不填或填0会删除全部内容'); followers keep the message card. Only article (mpnews) and video sends can be deleted - '其他类型的消息一经发送，无法删除', so a text publish_text cannot be withdrawn (errcode 40008 / 40065).

not_offered.publish_image: Mass-sent images must be WeChat media_ids (images.media_ids) obtained by uploading the file first (https://developers.weixin.qq.com/doc/service/api/notify/message/api_sendall, 新增临时素材); the runtime has no multipart upload, and image URLs are not accepted.
not_offered.reply_comment: replyComment needs msg_data_id and index of the article besides user_comment_id (https://developers.weixin.qq.com/doc/service/api/leaving/api_replycomment); a comment id alone cannot address it.
not_offered.read_mentions: Official Accounts have no mention concept; user messages are pushed to the account's callback URL only (https://developers.weixin.qq.com/doc/service/guide/).
not_offered.analytics_post: Article statistics (datacube getarticlesummary / getarticletotal) are queried by begin_date / end_date for the whole account, not by a post id (https://developers.weixin.qq.com/doc/service/api/).
